title: Tracking Semantic Change in Slovene: A Novel Dataset and Optimal Transport-Based Distance
reasoning: The paper focuses on the automatic detection and evaluation of semantic change using computational methods and a new dataset. While it touches upon societal and cultural changes as drivers of semantic change, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its research.
